zones.label: AMP 1
zones.description: AMP 1 sits along the stage-side edge of the room. It puts you close to the performance area with a distinct side angle.

zones.label: AMP 2
zones.description: AMP 2 is a stage-side section with a close view toward the performance area and a more angled perspective than the main center sections.

zones.label: AMP 3
zones.description: AMP 3 is another stage-side option. It keeps the stage close while giving you a side-on view of the room.

zones.label: Booths
zones.description: The booths run through the central aisle between the main seating blocks. They offer a more separated seating setup with a clear angle toward the stage.
